option.name: --help
tip: Display this help.

option.name: --verbose
tip: Be more verbose for some error conditions.

option.name: --version
tip: Display version information.

option.name: -a
tip: Display all interfaces, even those that are down.

option.name: -allmulti
tip: Disable all-multicast mode.

option.name: -arp
tip: Disable the use of the ARP protocol on this interface.

option.name: -broadcast
tip: Clear the broadcast flag.

option.name: -dynamic
tip: Clear the dynamic flag of the interface.

option.name: -pointopoint
tip: Disable point-to-point mode.

option.name: -promisc
tip: Disable promiscuous mode.

option.name: -s
tip: Display a short list (like netstat -i).

option.name: -trailers
tip: Disable trailer encapsulation.

option.name: add
tip: Add an IPv6 address to the interface.

option.name: allmulti
tip: Enable all-multicast mode.

option.name: arp
tip: Enable the use of the ARP protocol on this interface.

option.name: ash
tip: Use the ash address family.

option.name: ax25
tip: Use the ax25 address family.

option.name: broadcast
tip: Set the broadcast address, or set the broadcast flag.

option.name: ddp
tip: Use the ddp address family.

option.name: del
tip: Remove an IPv6 address from the interface.

option.name: down
tip: Shut down the interface.

option.name: dstaddr
tip: Set the remote IP address for a point-to-point link (obsolete; use pointopoint).

option.name: dynamic
tip: Mark the interface as dynamically created.

option.name: ec
tip: Use the ec address family.

option.name: hw
tip: Set the hardware address of this interface.

option.name: inet
tip: Use the inet address family.

option.name: inet6
tip: Use the inet6 address family.

option.name: io_addr
tip: Set the start address in I/O space for this device.

option.name: ipx
tip: Use the ipx address family.

option.name: irq
tip: Set the interrupt line used by this device.

option.name: keepalive
tip: Set the keepalive value for SLIP devices.

option.name: media
tip: Set the physical port or medium type used by the device.

option.name: mem_start
tip: Set the start address of shared memory used by this device.

option.name: mtu
tip: Set the maximum transfer unit of the interface.

option.name: multicast
tip: Set the multicast flag on the interface.

option.name: name
tip: Change the name of this interface.

option.name: netmask
tip: Set the IP network mask for this interface.

option.name: netrom
tip: Use the netrom address family.

option.name: outfill
tip: Set the outfill value for SLIP devices.

option.name: pointopoint
tip: Enable point-to-point mode and optionally set the peer address.

option.name: promisc
tip: Enable promiscuous mode.

option.name: rose
tip: Use the rose address family.

option.name: trailers
tip: Enable trailer encapsulation.

option.name: tunnel
tip: Create a new SIT device tunnelling to the destination.

option.name: txqueuelen
tip: Set the length of the transmit queue of the device.

option.name: unix
tip: Use the unix address family.

option.name: up
tip: Activate the interface.

option.name: x25
tip: Use the x25 address family.
